Validations: Not available if Remittance Instructions are Check or Interdepartmental Transfer (IDTS). Defaults to No. When Yes, all cashflows associated with this transaction are automatically flagged as Do It when created so that they are automatically released when the transaction is released. If the Payment Method and Direction noted in the Remittance Instruction indicates that the instruction can be used only for some type of incoming money transfer, then the Auto Do It feature does not apply, and the Auto Do It indicator is disabled.

Remittance Method Type_x000D_ Notes:_x000D_ • Book Transfer is not available to a customer who is a Host Bank Legal Entity._x000D_ • While cashflows between Host Bank Lenders are limited to IDDA (Interco/DDA), cashflows for Host Bank Borrowers cannot be Interco/DDA, but may use the regular DDA payment method._x000D_ • Check is allowed for Host Bank Remittance Instruction. For incoming cashflows (from borrowers and lenders) that are Fed, Local Clearing, and Check, the system looks for the first Host Bank Remittance Instruction in the Facility main SG that has the same Payment Method and picks up the Host Bank ABA # or check address and prints it on the fax (or borrower bill).

External Customer ID._x000D_ Validation: The Customer ID that uniquely identifies the Customer. An active Lender or borrower Profile must exist, and it must have at least one completed location. The Location and Servicing Group default to the only available choices, if possible. The system defaults the Servicing Group to the active choice that has been flagged as the standard Servicing Group for that lender location if more than one exists. If more than one choice for the Location and/or Servicing Group exists, the client can supply this information via the Deal API.
